transcript.text:
Thanks, Mina and Caleb — I appreciate you both sharing those details. Let me make sure I have everything I need before I finalize the arrangement.

Mina, you've told me about the planer: you have a clear 120-centimeter west bench in your garage next to a 240-volt outlet, so that's a secure, level spot. And you have a specific project — an accessibility ramp for our aunt.

Caleb, you've told me about the scroll saw: you've got a dry 90-centimeter shelf where it can stay set up permanently, and you need it for restoring Grandpa's unfinished birdhouse.

Before I make my final call, I want to check with both of you on a couple of things. First, the planer is bulky and will need a two-person carry — can each of you confirm you'd be available to help with that, or that you can arrange a second person? Second, regarding the locked chest of hand tools — neither of you has mentioned it yet. Do either of you have a need for it, or a secure place to store it? I want to make sure all three items are accounted for before I settle this.
